title: Building and selling a food business with Smiqql's Dina Holzapfel
summary: Dina Holzapfel walks through selling Smiqql, the Swiss flaky-salt-and-cookie company she built with her life partner Merat after four years of farmer's markets, 2 a.m. production shifts, and blurred lines between business and relationship. She unpacks the five criteria she now uses to evaluate any new venture, why she'll never again build a physical-product company that requires her to bake at scale, and the unexpected relief of getting her relationship back after the sale. Along the way she talks about her career zigzag from environmental engineering to oil rigs in Iraq to venture capital to food entrepreneurship, and the psychology and neuroscience masters she's started while plotting a future PhD.
topics: building a company with a life partner
criteria for choosing a next venture

using chatgpt as a tutor and legal drafter
